source_results.motivation: v069 showed that the naive first upward crossing is highly grid-sensitive, while many Delta_L^2 threshold locations overlap the k~0.08--0.20 h/Mpc response-transition region. v070 therefore replaces the pointwise first-crossing observable by a preregistered broadband log-k band average and evaluates its eta=0 threshold tangent implicitly at the baseline crossing.

scope: Linear-theory broadband onset diagnostic only. No nonlinear evolution, nonlinear saturation, halo dynamics, screening, N-body dynamics, or observational likelihood is used.

direct_spectrum_grid.evaluation: Direct classy.pk_lin at every requested (k,z); no CLASS native-grid P(k) interpolation.

dimensionless_power.definition: Delta_L^2(k,z)=k^3 P_L(k,z)/(2 pi^2), with k in 1/Mpc and P_L in Mpc^3
dimensionless_power.broadband_definition: For x=ln k and width W, Dbar_W(x,z)=(1/W) integral_{x-W/2}^{x+W/2} Delta_L^2(exp(u),z) du. Only centers whose full top-hat window lies inside the direct k range are used.
dimensionless_power.baseline_crossing_rule: For each W, threshold, and redshift, take the first upward crossing of Dbar_W as x increases; interpolate ln Dbar_W linearly versus ln k between neighboring evaluated centers.
dimensionless_power.reason_for_broadband_definition: A nonlinear regime is a broadband statement. The fixed top-hat average reduces sensitivity to isolated narrow excursions that made the v069 first-point crossing grid-dependent. Two widths are fixed before the result and both are reported.

implicit_tangent.definition: At each baseline broadband threshold crossing, d ln k_thr/d eta = - [partial_eta ln Dbar_W] / [partial_ln_k ln Dbar_W].
implicit_tangent.partial_eta_ln_Dbar: [ln Dbar_W(+lambda)-ln Dbar_W(-lambda)]/(2 lambda), evaluated at the baseline crossing.
implicit_tangent.partial_ln_k_ln_Dbar: Derivative of the baseline broadband ln Dbar_W with respect to ln k, evaluated at the baseline crossing.
implicit_tangent.interpretation_if_positive: Positive eta shifts the broadband threshold to larger k, consistent with delaying the linear-theory approach to a broadband nonlinear regime.
implicit_tangent.interpretation_if_negative: Positive eta shifts the broadband threshold to smaller k, consistent with advancing that linear-theory approach.

science_classification_after_numerical_p.delay: V070_BROADBAND_MEMORY_DELAY_SUPPORTED if, for both preregistered widths, at least 5/7 Delta_L^2=1 implicit mean shifts are positive and the two widths agree in sign at least 6/7 redshifts.
science_classification_after_numerical_p.advance: V070_BROADBAND_MEMORY_ADVANCE_SUPPORTED if, for both preregistered widths, at least 5/7 Delta_L^2=1 implicit mean shifts are negative and the two widths agree in sign at least 6/7 redshifts.
science_classification_after_numerical_p.mixed: V070_BROADBAND_ONSET_SHIFT_MIXED otherwise, provided all numerical gates pass.
science_classification_after_numerical_p.numerical_fail: V070_BROADBAND_NONLINEAR_ONSET_TANGENT_FAIL if any primary numerical gate fails.

secondary_descriptive_tests.transition_overlap: Report the fraction of baseline broadband threshold crossings in k=0.08--0.20 h/Mpc, preserving the v068 transition band only as historical context.
secondary_descriptive_tests.threshold_dependence: Report median absolute implicit shift for Delta_L^2=0.1, 0.3, and 1.0 for each broadband width.
secondary_descriptive_tests.width_dependence: Report sign concordance and amplitude differences between W=0.1 and W=0.2; neither width may be selected post hoc as preferred.

anti_tuning: The physical model, tangent amplitudes, direct k/z grid, thresholds, broadband widths, implicit-derivative definition, numerical gates, and science-classification rule are committed before the v070 result. Historical v067--v069 classifications and artifacts remain unchanged.
